videos.caption: Let’s make roti teflon 🍞🫓✨ Bahan: 250 gr tepung terigu protein tinggi 3 gr ragi 25 gr gula pasir 1 butir telur 150 ml susu full cream (dingin) 25 gr margarin 2 gr garam Cara membuat: 1. Campurkan tepung, ragi, gula, telur, dan susu. Mixing hingga setengah kalis. 2. Masukkan margarin dan garam, lalu mixing kembali hingga kalis. 3. Bulk proof selama 30 menit. 4. Bagi adonan menjadi 6–8 bagian, bentuk, lalu resting kembali selama 15 menit. 5. Isi dengan cokelat, rapatkan, dan bentuk kembali. 6. Proofing selama 30 menit. 7. Panaskan teflon, lalu panggang dengan api kecil dan tutup teflon. Panggang masing-masing sisi sekitar ±5 menit atau hingga matang dan kecokelatan.

Ragi Roti and Glucose Spike 📉📈 Is Ragi actually the "magical healthy alternative" we all think it is? We put it to the ultimate Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) test, and the results were absolutely shocking. 🤯 Yesterday, regular wheat (aata) roti gave us a massive spike, leaving us super stressed. So, we tested the exact same weight of Ragi roti today, expecting much safer numbers. We waited a few hours, checked the monitor, and... trust me, you are not ready for this. My spike was a complete record-breaker—it matched the exact same spike I got from drinking straight pineapple juice!  And my mom's graph? It shot up even higher than the regular wheat roti! 📈 My mom used to have diabetes, but she brought it completely under control two years ago by giving up all types of roti. This test proved exactly why. I even pulled out the packets to compare the nutrition labels, and the truth about Ragi's fiber and net carbs compared to regular wheat will surprise you. The numbers don't lie. Watch the video to see the real-time graph and the final numbers! If you are looking for truly healthy, low-spike alternatives, check out my page for recipes like my Tofu Scramble, Gajar Ka Halwa, and Chocolate Pudding. ✅ Next up: We are testing Bajra ki Roti. You can try traditional Latvian food like 🫛🥓 grey peas with bacon, 🥟 piragi and 🍪 gingerbread, along with steaming cups of mulled wine and Riga Black Balsam. 🎶 There are also live performances, traditional Latvian folk music, carol singing and dancing throughout the festive season.
